title.zh: 卷二十三 本紀第二十三 欽宗
title.raw: 卷二十三 本紀第二十三 欽宗 Volume 23 Annals 23: Qinzong

sentences.zh: 欽宗恭文順德仁孝皇帝，諱桓，徽宗皇帝長子，母曰恭顯皇后王氏。

translations.literal: Emperor Qinzong, the Respectful, Cultured, Shun, Virtuous, Benevolent, and Filial, taboo name Huan, eldest son of Huizong, mother the Empress Gongxian of the Wang clan.
translations.idiomatic: Qinzong, the Respectful, Cultured, Shun, Virtuous, Benevolent, and Filial Emperor—taboo name Huan—was Huizong’s eldest son; his mother was Empress Gongxian Wang.

sentences.zh: 元符三年四月乙酉生於坤寧殿。

translations.literal: In Yuanfu year 3, fourth month, day yiyou, he was born in the Hall of Earthly Tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfu 3, fourth month, yiyou: he was born in the Hall of Earthly Tranquility.

sentences.zh: 初名亶，封韓國公，明年六月進封京兆郡王。

translations.literal: His first name was Dan; he was enfeoffed Duke of Han, and in the sixth month of the next year advanced to Prince of Jingzhao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: First named Dan, he became Duke of Han, then in the sixth month of the next year Prince of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 崇甯元年二月甲午，更名烜，十一月丁亥，又改今名。

translations.literal: Chongning year 1, second month, day jiawu, his name was changed to Xuan; eleventh month, day dinghai, it was changed again to his present name.
translations.idiomatic: Chongning 1, second month, jiawu: he was renamed Xuan; eleventh month, dinghai: renamed again to Huan.

sentences.zh: 大觀二年正月，進封定王。

translations.literal: Daguan year 2, first month, he was advanced to Prince of Ding.
translations.idiomatic: Daguan 2, first month: he became Prince of Ding.

sentences.zh: 政和元年三月，講學於資善堂。

translations.literal: Zhenghe year 1, third month, he studied at the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe 1, third month: he lectured at the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，加太保。

translations.literal: Year 3, first month, he was made Junior Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3, first month: he took Junior Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 四年二月癸酉，冠於文德殿。

translations.literal: Year 4, second month, day guiyou, he received the capping rite in the Hall of Civil Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Year 4, second month, guiyou: he was capped in the Hall of Civil Virtue.

sentences.zh: 五年二月乙巳，立為皇太子，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Year 5, second month, day yisi, he was installed as crown prince; the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Year 5, second month, yisi: he became crown prince and the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，謁太廟。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: he visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, he visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 詔乘金輅，設鹵簿，如至道、天禧故事，及宮僚參謁並稱臣，皆辭之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him to ride the golden chariot with full guard of honor, as in the Zhidao and Tianxi precedents, and that palace staff attending him should address him as “minister”—all were declined.
translations.idiomatic: He was offered the golden chariot and full guard of Zhidao and Tianxi days, with palace staff to call him “minister”—he refused all.

sentences.zh: 六年六月癸未，納妃朱氏。

translations.literal: Year 6, sixth month, day guiwei, he took Lady Zhu as consort.
translations.idiomatic: Year 6, sixth month, guiwei: he wed Lady Zhu.

sentences.zh: 宣和七年十二月戊午，除開封牧。

translations.literal: Xuanhe year 7, twelfth month, day wuwu, he was made metropolitan governor of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 7, twelfth month, wuwu: he became Kaifeng metropolitan governor.

sentences.zh: 庚申，徽宗詔皇太子嗣位，自稱曰「道君皇帝」，趣太子入禁中，被以御服。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Huizong decreed that the crown prince should succeed; he styled himself “Lord Emperor of the Dao” and urged the prince into the inner palace, clothing him in imperial robes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Huizong abdicated in favor of the crown prince, styled himself Lord Emperor of the Dao, and had the heir brought in and dressed in imperial robes.

sentences.zh: 泣涕固辭，因得疾。

translations.literal: Weeping, he firmly declined and fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: He wept, refused again, and fell ill.

sentences.zh: 又固辭，不許。

translations.literal: He declined again; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He refused once more; they would not hear it.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，即皇帝位，御垂拱殿見群臣。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: he took the throne and received the ministers in the Hall of Hanging Bow.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, he ascended and received the court at the Hall of Hanging Bow.

sentences.zh: 是日，日有五色暈，挾赤黃珥，重日相蕩摩久之。

translations.literal: That day the sun showed a five-colored halo with red and yellow “ears”; a secondary sun oscillated against it for a long while.
translations.idiomatic: That day a five-colored halo ringed the sun, red-yellow ears dangling; a second sun swayed against it long minutes.

sentences.zh: 乃引道君皇帝出居龍德宮，皇后出居擷景園。

translations.literal: Then the Lord Emperor of the Dao was led out to dwell at the Palace of Dragon Virtue, and the empress moved to the Garden of Gathering Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong was moved to the Palace of Dragon Virtue; the empress to the Garden of Gathering Splendor.

sentences.zh: 以少宰李邦彥為龍德宮使，太保、領樞密院事蔡攸、門下侍郎吳敏副之。

translations.literal: Junior Chancellor Li Bangyan was made commissioner of the Palace of Dragon Virtue; Junior Grand Guardian and Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Cai You and Vice Director of the Chancellery Wu Min were his deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bangyan oversaw Dragon Virtue Palace; Cai You and Wu Min served as deputies.

sentences.zh: 是時，金人已分道犯境。

translations.literal: At that time Jin forces were already invading by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: By then Jin columns were already crossing the borders.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，赦大逆、反叛以下罪，進百官秩一等，賞諸軍，立妃朱氏為皇后，以太子詹事耿南仲簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day renxu: pardon was granted for crimes below great treason and rebellion; all officials’ ranks rose one step; the armies were rewarded; consort Zhu was made empress; crown-prince tutor Geng Nanzhong was made signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, crimes short of treason were pardoned, ranks lifted, troops paid, Lady Zhu crowned, and Geng Nanzhong made signatory of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔太傅燕王、越王入朝不趨，贊拜不名。

translations.literal: Day guihai: an edict—Grand Preceptor, Prince of Yan, and Prince of Yue need not hasten in audience and need not have their names spoken in obeisance.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the Princes of Yan and Yue were excused from hurrying to court and from having their names called in obeisance.

sentences.zh: 詔非三省、樞密院所得旨，有司勿行。

translations.literal: An edict: orders not from the Three Departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs were not to be carried out by the ministries.
translations.idiomatic: Only orders from the Three Departments and Military Affairs Bureau were to run the ministries.

sentences.zh: 甲子，斡離不陷信德府，粘罕圍太原。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Wanyan Zonghan took Xinde prefecture; Nianhan besieged Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Wanyan Zonghan took Xinde; Nianhan besieged Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 詔京東、淮西、浙募兵入衛。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jingdong, Huai west, and Zhe circuits to levy troops for capital defense.
translations.idiomatic: Jingdong, Huai west, and Zhe were ordered to raise troops for the capital.

sentences.zh: 太學生陳東等上書，數蔡京、童貫、王黼、梁師成、李彥、朱勔罪，謂之「六賊」，請誅之。

translations.literal: Imperial University students Chen Dong and others memorialized, listing the crimes of Cai Jing, Tong Guan, Wang Fu, Liang Shicheng, Li Yan, and Zhu Mian—the “Six Bandits”—and asking that they be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Students led by Chen Dong denounced the Six Bandits—Cai Jing, Tong Guan, Wang Fu, Liang Shicheng, Li Yan, and Zhu Mian—and demanded their heads.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上道君皇帝尊號曰教主道君太上皇帝，皇后曰道君太上皇后。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the Lord Emperor of the Dao was given the honorific Sagely Lord, Emperor Emeritus of the Dao; the empress became Daoist Empress Emeritus.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Huizong became Sagely Lord, Emperor Emeritus of the Dao; the empress, Daoist Empress Emeritus.

sentences.zh: 詔改元。

translations.literal: An edict changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: The reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年春正月丁卯朔，受群臣朝賀，退詣龍德宮，賀道君皇帝。

translations.literal: Jingkang year 1, spring, first month, day dingmao new moon: he received the ministers’ congratulations, then went to the Palace of Dragon Virtue to congratulate the Lord Emperor of the Dao.
translations.idiomatic: Jingkang 1, spring, dingmao new moon: after court congratulations he went to Dragon Virtue Palace to greet Huizong.

sentences.zh: 詔中外臣庶實封言得失。

translations.literal: An edict invited sealed memorials on gain and loss from officials and commoners throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The throne called for sealed memorials on what was right and wrong in government.

sentences.zh: 金人破相州。

translations.literal: Jin forces took Xiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jin took Xiang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，破濬州。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: they took Jun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Jin took Jun prefecture.

sentences.zh: 威武軍節度使梁方平師潰，河北、河東路制置副使何灌退保滑州。

translations.literal: Military commissioner of Weiwu army Liang Fangping’s army collapsed; He Guan, vice commissioner for Hebei and Hedong, withdrew to defend Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Fangping’s Weiwu army broke; He Guan, Hebei-Hedong vice commissioner, fell back on Hua.

sentences.zh: 己巳，灌奔還，金人濟河，詔親征。

translations.literal: Day jisi: He Guan fled back; Jin crossed the Yellow River; an edict ordered the emperor to campaign in person.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, He Guan ran; Jin crossed the Yellow River; Qinzong was told to take the field himself.

sentences.zh: 道君皇帝東巡，以領樞密院事蔡攸為行宮使，尚書右丞宇文粹中副之。

translations.literal: The Lord Emperor of the Dao toured east; Director of Military Affairs Cai You was made commissioner of the traveling palace; Vice Director of the Secretariat Yu Wen Cuizhong was deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong went east; Cai You ran his traveling palace with Yu Wen Cuizhong as deputy.

sentences.zh: 詔自今除授、黜陟及恩數等事，並參酌祖宗舊制。

translations.literal: An edict: from now on appointments, dismissals, and grants of favor were all to follow ancestral precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Appointments, dismissals, and favors were to follow ancestral precedent hereafter.

sentences.zh: 罷內外官司、局、所一百五處，止留後苑，以奉龍德宮。

translations.literal: One hundred five inner and outer offices, bureaus, and agencies were abolished; only the rear park remained, to supply the Palace of Dragon Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred five offices were struck; only the rear park was kept for Dragon Virtue Palace.

sentences.zh: 以門下侍郎吳敏知樞密院事，吏部尚書李棁同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Chancellery Wu Min was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Minister of Personnel Li Zhi was made associate director.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Min directed Military Affairs; Li Zhi served as associate.

sentences.zh: 貶太傅致仕王黼為崇信軍節度副使、安置永州。

translations.literal: Retired Grand Preceptor Wang Fu was demoted to military vice commissioner of Chongxin army and settled at Yong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fu, retired grand preceptor, was demoted to Chongxin vice commissioner and sent to Yong.

sentences.zh: 賜翊衛大夫、安德軍承宣使李彥死，並籍其家。

translations.literal: Assistant commander of the Guard Li Yan was sentenced to death and his household was registered for confiscation.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yan of the Guard was executed and his property seized.

sentences.zh: 放甯遠軍節度使朱勔歸田裏。

translations.literal: Military commissioner of Ningyuan army Zhu Mian was released to his home village.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Mian of Ningyuan was sent home to his village.

sentences.zh: 帝欲親征，以李綱為留守，以李棁為副。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to campaign in person; Li Gang was left as capital defender; Li Zhi as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Qinzong meant to take the field; Li Gang was left to hold the capital with Li Zhi as deputy.

sentences.zh: 給事中王寓諫親征，罷之。

translations.literal: Supervisor of the Secretariat Wang Yu remonstrated against personal campaigning; it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yu talked him out of going in person.

sentences.zh: 庚午，道君皇帝如亳州，百官多潛遁。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the Lord Emperor of the Dao went to Bozhou; many officials fled in secret.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Huizong reached Bozhou while officials slipped away by night.

sentences.zh: 宰相欲奉帝出襄、鄧，李綱諫止之。

translations.literal: The council wished to move the emperor to Xiang and Deng; Li Gang remonstrated and stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: The council wanted the court at Xiang and Deng; Li Gang blocked it.

sentences.zh: 以綱為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Li Gang was made Vice Director of the Right of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang became right secretariat vice director.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以李綱為親征行營使，侍衛親軍馬軍都指揮使曹曚副之。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Li Gang was made commissioner of the Personal Campaign Headquarters; Cao Meng, commander of the Palace Horse Guard, was deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Li Gang headed the Personal Campaign Headquarters with Cao Meng of the Horse Guard as deputy.

sentences.zh: 太宰兼門下侍郎白時中罷。

translations.literal: Grand Chancellor concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery Bai Shizhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Shizhong left the grand chancellery.

sentences.zh: 李邦彥為太宰兼門下侍郎，守中書侍郎張邦昌為少宰兼中書侍郎，尚書左丞趙野為門下侍郎，翰林學士承旨王孝迪為中書侍郎，同知樞密院事蔡懋為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: Li Bangyan became Grand Chancellor concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery; Vice Director of the Secretariat Zhang Bangchang became Junior Chancellor concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat; Vice Director of the Left Zhao Ye became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Hanlin Academic Debater Wang Xiaodi became Vice Director of the Secretariat; Associate Director of Military Affairs Cai Mao became Vice Director of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bangyan took the grand chancellery; Zhang Bangchang the junior secretariat; Zhao Ye the chancellery; Wang Xiaodi the secretariat; Cai Mao the left vice director.

sentences.zh: 壬申，金人渡河，遣使督諸道兵入援。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Jin crossed the river; envoys were sent to hurry troops from every route to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Jin crossed the river; envoys raced to summon relief from every circuit.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔兩省、樞密院官制一遵元豐故事。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: an edict—the offices of the Two Departments and Military Affairs were to follow Yuanfeng organization entirely.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the Two Departments and Military Affairs were ordered back to Yuanfeng forms.

sentences.zh: 金人犯京師，命尚書駕部員外郎鄭望之、親衛大夫康州防禦使高世則使其軍。

translations.literal: Jin threatened the capital; Minister of the Imperial Stud Zheng Wangzhi and Guard commander, defender of Kang prefecture Gao Shize were sent to their camp.
translations.idiomatic: As Jin closed on the capital, Zheng Wangzhi and Gao Shize were sent to the Jin camp.

sentences.zh: 詔從官舉文武臣僚堪充將帥有膽勇者。

translations.literal: An edict ordered attendant officials to recommend civil and military officers fit for command who had courage.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants were told to name civil and military men bold enough to lead.

sentences.zh: 是夜，金人攻宣澤門，李綱禦之，斬獲百餘人，至旦始退。

translations.literal: That night Jin attacked the Xuande Gate; Li Gang defended it, beheading and capturing over a hundred; they withdrew only at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: That night Jin hit the Xuande Gate; Li Gang held, killed or captured a hundred, and drove them off at dawn.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，金人遣吳孝民來議和，命李棁使金軍。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Jin sent Wu Xiaomin to negotiate peace; Li Zhi was sent to the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Wu Xiaomin came to parley; Li Zhi went to the Jin camp.

sentences.zh: 金人又使蕭三寶奴、耶律忠、張願恭來。

translations.literal: Jin also sent Xiao Sanbaonu, Yelü Zhong, and Zhang Yugong.
translations.idiomatic: Jin also sent Xiao Sanbaonu, Yelü Zhong, and Zhang Yugong.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書唐恪同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Tang Que was made associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Que became associate director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，金人攻通津、景陽等門，李綱督戰，自卯至酉，斬首數千級，何灌戰死。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Jin attacked the Tongjin, Jingyang, and other gates; Li Gang directed the fighting from mao to you, beheading several thousand; He Guan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Jin stormed Tongjin and Jingyang gates; Li Gang fought from dawn to dusk, took thousands of heads; He Guan fell.

sentences.zh: 李棁與蕭三寶奴、耶律忠、王汭來索金帛數千萬，且求割太原、中山、河間三鎮，並宰相、親王為質，乃退師，丙子，避正殿，減常膳。

translations.literal: Li Zhi came with Xiao Sanbaonu, Yelü Zhong, and Wang Yu demanding tens of millions in gold and silk, and also the cession of Taiyuan, Zhongshan, and Hejian—three prefectures—and a chief minister and imperial prince as hostages before they would withdraw; day bingzi: the emperor left the main hall and reduced his daily meals.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhi returned with Xiao Sanbaonu, Yelü Zhong, and Wang Yu demanding millions in gold and silk, the three prefectures of Taiyuan, Zhongshan, and Hejian, and a chief minister and prince as hostages before they would leave; on bingzi Qinzong left the main hall and cut his table.

sentences.zh: 括借金銀，籍倡優家財。

translations.literal: Gold and silver were requisitioned by search; entertainers’ households were registered for confiscation.
translations.idiomatic: Gold and silver were scraped up; actors’ homes were inventoried for seizure.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命張邦昌副康王構使金軍，詔稱金國加「大」字。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Zhang Bangchang was ordered to accompany Prince Kang Gou to the Jin army; an edict styled the Jin state with the character “Great.”
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Zhang Bangchang went with Prince Kang Gou to Jin; edicts called the Jin state “Great.”

sentences.zh: 辛巳，道君皇帝幸鎮江。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the Lord Emperor of the Dao reached Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Huizong reached Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 以兵部尚書路允迪簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Minister of War Lu Yundi was made signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yundi became signatory of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 金人陷陽武，知縣事蔣興祖死之。

translations.literal: Jin took Yangwu; magistrate Jiang Xingzu died.
translations.idiomatic: Jin took Yangwu; magistrate Jiang Xingzu died defending it.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大風走石，竟日乃止。

translations.literal: Day renwu: a great wind drove stones; it stopped only at day’s end.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, a gale hurled stones until evening.

sentences.zh: 封子諶為大寧郡王。

translations.literal: The son Chen was enfeoffed Prince of Daning commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The son Chen was made Prince of Daning.

sentences.zh: 甲申，省廉訪使者官，罷鈔旁定貼錢及諸州免行錢，以諸路贍學戶絕田產歸常平司。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: circuit investigation commissioners’ posts were cut; surcharges on paper money and exemption fees in the prefectures were abolished; abandoned school-support fields in the circuits were returned to the Ever-Normal Granary.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, circuit investigators were cut, money surcharges ended, and school lands went back to the Ever-Normal Granary.

sentences.zh: 統制官馬忠以京西募兵至，擊金人於順天門外，敗之。

translations.literal: Commander Ma Zhong brought Jingxi levies; he struck Jin outside the Gate of Compliance with Heaven and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zhong’s Jingxi levies arrived and beat Jin outside the Gate of Compliance with Heaven.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，路允迪使粘罕軍於河東。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Lu Yundi was sent to Nianhan’s army in Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Lu Yundi went to Nianhan in Hedong.

sentences.zh: 平陽府將劉嗣初以城叛。

translations.literal: Pingyang prefecture commander Liu Sichu surrendered the city in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Sichu of Pingyang turned the city over to Jin.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，靖難軍節度使、河北河東路制置使种師道督涇原、秦鳳兵入援，以師道同知樞密院事，為京畿、河北、河東宣撫使，統四方勤王兵及前後軍。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Jingnan military commissioner and Hebei-Hedong commissioner Zhong Shidao led Jingyuan and Qinfeng troops to the rescue; Zhong Shidao was made associate director of Military Affairs, commissioner for capital region, Hebei, and Hedong, and commander of relief armies from all quarters and of former and later corps.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Zhong Shidao marched Jingyuan and Qinfeng men to the rescue, became associate director of Military Affairs, and commanded all relief forces for the capital, Hebei, and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，盜殺王黼於雍丘。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: bandits killed Wang Fu at Yongqiu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Wang Fu was killed by bandits at Yongqiu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，大霧四塞。

translations.literal: Day guisi: thick fog closed in on all sides.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, fog walled the city.

sentences.zh: 乙未，貶少保、淮南節度使梁師成為彰化軍節度副使，行及八角鎮，賜 死。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Junior Guardian, Huainan military commissioner Liang Shicheng was demoted to vice commissioner of Zhanghua army; on the road at Bajiao post he was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Liang Shicheng was demoted to Zhanghua vice commissioner and granted death at Bajiao post.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉朔，命都統制姚平仲將兵夜襲金人軍，不克而奔。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingyou new moon: overall commander Yao Pingzhong led troops in a night assault on the Jin camp; it failed and he fled.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dingyou new moon: Yao Pingzhong’s night raid on the Jin camp failed and he fled.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，罷李綱以謝金人，廢親征行營司。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Li Gang was dismissed to appease Jin; the Personal Campaign Headquarters was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Li Gang was removed to please Jin; the Personal Campaign Headquarters was struck.

sentences.zh: 金人復來議和。

translations.literal: Jin came again to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: Jin returned to talk peace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命附馬都尉曹晟使金軍。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Commandant-in-chief Cao Cheng was sent to the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Cao Cheng went to the Jin camp.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，又命資政殿大學士宇文虛中、知東上閣門事王球使之，許割三鎮地。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Yu Wen Xuzhong and director of the Eastern Upper Gate Wang Qiu were also sent; the cession of the three prefectures was agreed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Yu Wen Xuzhong and Wang Qiu followed; the three prefectures were promised.

sentences.zh: 太學諸生陳東等及都民數萬人伏闕上書，請復用李綱及种師道，且言李邦彥等疾綱，恐其成功，罷綱正墮金人之計。

translations.literal: University students Chen Dong and others and tens of thousands of capital people knelt at the palace gate, asking that Li Gang and Zhong Shidao be restored, and saying Li Bangyan and others hated Gang and feared his success—dismissing Gang was exactly what Jin wanted.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dong and tens of thousands knelt at the gate demanding Li Gang and Zhong Shidao back, accusing Li Bangyan of hating Gang—dismissing him was Jin’s plan.

sentences.zh: 會邦彥入朝，眾數其罪而罵。

translations.literal: When Bangyan entered court, the crowd counted his crimes and cursed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Bangyan entered court, the crowd shouted his crimes at him.

sentences.zh: 吳敏傳宣，眾不退，遂撾登聞鼓，山呼動地。

translations.literal: Wu Min announced the throne’s words; the crowd would not leave, beat the petition drum, and their shouts shook the earth.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Min read the edict; the crowd would not budge, beat the petition drum, and roared till the ground shook.

sentences.zh: 殿帥王宗濋恐生變，奏上勉從之。

translations.literal: Palace Guard commander Wang Zongfu, fearing disorder, memorialized that the throne should reluctantly agree.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing riot, Guard commander Wang Zongfu urged the throne to yield.

sentences.zh: 遣耿南仲號於眾曰：「已得旨宣綱矣。

translations.literal: Geng Nanzhong was sent to shout to the crowd: “The edict to restore Gang has already been issued.”
translations.idiomatic: Geng Nanzhong cried out: “Gang is already restored by edict.”

sentences.zh: 」內侍朱拱之宣綱後期，眾臠而磔之，並殺內侍數十人。

translations.literal: The eunuch Zhu Gongzhi announced Gang’s restoration late; the crowd tore him apart and dismembered him, and killed several dozen eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Zhu Gongzhi announced too late; the mob tore him apart and killed dozens of eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 乃復綱右丞，充京城防禦使。

translations.literal: Then Gang was restored as right vice director and made capital defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang returned as right vice director and capital defender.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，追封范仲淹魏國公，贈司馬光太師，張商英太保，除元祐黨籍學術之禁。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Fan Zhongyan was posthumously enfeoffed Duke of Wei; Sima Guang was given Grand Preceptor; Zhang Shangying Junior Grand Guardian; the ban on Yuanyou faction scholars was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Fan Zhongyan was made Duke of Wei posthumously, Sima Guang Grand Preceptor, Zhang Shangying Junior Grand Guardian, and Yuanyou faction bans were lifted.

sentences.zh: 詔誅士民殺內侍為首者，禁伏闕上書，廢苑囿宮觀可以與民者。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the execution of commoners who had led in killing eunuchs; kneeling petitions at the gate were forbidden; palace parks and Daoist halls that could be given to the people were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Leaders among those who killed eunuchs were to die; gate petitions were banned; parks and halls usable by the people were turned over.

sentences.zh: 金人使王汭來。

translations.literal: Jin sent Wang Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Jin sent Wang Yu.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命肅王樞使金軍。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Prince Su was sent as envoy to the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Prince Su went to the Jin camp.

sentences.zh: 以觀文殿學士、大名尹徐處仁為中書侍郎，宇文虛中簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Palace academician and Daming intendant Xu Churen was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; Yu Wen Xuzhong signatory of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Churen became secretariat vice director; Yu Wen Xuzhong signatory of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 蔡懋罷。

translations.literal: Cai Mao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Mao left office.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，宇文虛中、王球復使金軍。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Yu Wen Xuzhong and Wang Qiu were again sent to the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Yu Wen Xuzhong and Wang Qiu went again to Jin.

sentences.zh: 康王至自金軍。

translations.literal: Prince Kang returned from the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Kang came back from Jin.

sentences.zh: 金人遣韓光裔來告辭，遂退師，京師解嚴。

translations.literal: Jin sent Han Guangyi to announce their departure; they withdrew and the capital stood down.
translations.idiomatic: Jin sent Han Guangyi to say farewell, pulled back, and the capital stood down.

sentences.zh: 丙午，康王構為太傅、靜江奉甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Prince Kang Gou was made Grand Preceptor and military commissioner of Jingjiang Fengning army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Prince Kang Gou became Grand Preceptor and Jingjiang Fengning commissioner.

sentences.zh: 省明堂班朔布政官。

translations.literal: The Bright Hall monthly audience and policy announcement offices were cut.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Hall monthly audiences and policy posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 丁未，日有兩珥。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the sun had two “ears.”
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, two solar “ears” appeared.

sentences.zh: 戊申，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 詔諭士民，自今庶事並遵用祖宗舊制，凡蠹國害民之事，一切寢罷。

translations.literal: An edict instructed the people: from now on all affairs were to follow ancestral institutions; every matter that harmed the state and injured the people was to be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: The throne told the people: hereafter follow ancestral ways; every state-rotting, people-harming practice was dead.

sentences.zh: 己酉，罷宰執兼神霄玉清萬壽宮使及殿中監、符寶郎。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: concurrent commissioners of the Jade Clarity Longevity Palace of the Sagely Auspice and the palace director and seal keeper were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, councilors’ concurrent Daoist palace posts and seal keepers were struck.

sentences.zh: 詔用祖宗故事，擇武臣得軍心者為同知、簽書樞密院，邊將有威望者為三衙。

translations.literal: An edict followed ancestral story: military men who held the army’s heart were to be associate and signatory directors of Military Affairs; border generals of standing were to head the Three Guards.
translations.idiomatic: By ancestral rule, soldiers’ favorites would run Military Affairs; famed border generals would head the Three Guards.

sentences.zh: 以金人請和，詔官民昔嘗附金而復歸本朝者，各還其鄉國。

translations.literal: Because Jin sought peace, an edict: officials and people who had once submitted to Jin and returned to the Song were each to go back to their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: With Jin asking peace, those who had once served Jin and returned to Song were sent home to their districts.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，李邦彥罷，以張邦昌為太宰兼門下侍郎，吳敏為少宰兼中書侍郎，李綱知樞密院事，耿南仲為尚書左丞，李棁為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Li Bangyan was dismissed; Zhang Bangchang became Grand Chancellor concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery; Wu Min Junior Chancellor concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat; Li Gang director of Military Affairs; Geng Nanzhong Vice Director of the Left; Li Zhi Vice Director of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Li Bangyan fell; Zhang Bangchang took the grand chancellery; Wu Min the junior secretariat; Li Gang Military Affairs; Geng Nanzhong left vice director; Li Zhi right.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔監察御史言事如祖宗法。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: an edict—investigating censors were to speak as in ancestral law.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, censors were told to speak as under the ancestors.

sentences.zh: 宇文粹中罷知江寧府。

translations.literal: Yu Wen Cuizhong was dismissed and made prefect of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Wen Cuizhong left court for Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，种師道罷為中太一宮使。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Zhong Shidao was dismissed and made commissioner of the Central Grand Unity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zhong Shidao became commissioner of the Central Grand Unity Palace.

sentences.zh: 贈右正言陳瓘為右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: Right rectifier Chen Guan was posthumously made right remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guan was posthumously made right remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，貶太師致仕蔡京為秘書監、分局南京，太師、廣陽郡王童貫為左衛上將軍，太保、領樞密院事蔡攸為太中大夫、提舉亳州明道宮。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: retired Grand Preceptor Cai Jing was demoted to palace librarian and assigned to Nanjing; Grand Preceptor, Prince of Guangyang Tong Guan to left guard senior general; Junior Grand Guardian and Director of Military Affairs Cai You to grand master of the palace and commissioner of Bozhou Mingdao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Cai Jing became palace librarian at Nanjing; Tong Guan left guard senior general; Cai You grand master at Bozhou Mingdao Palace.

sentences.zh: 先是，粘罕遣人來求賂，大臣以勤王兵大集，拘其使人，且結約餘睹以圖之。

translations.literal: Earlier Nianhan had sent men demanding bribes; the ministers, because relief armies were massing, detained his envoys and also made terms with Yelü Dashi to plot against him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Nianhan’s envoys had asked for bribes; ministers, seeing relief armies gather, held the envoys and courted Yelü Dashi.

sentences.zh: 至是，粘罕怒，及攻太原不克，分兵趣京師，過南、北關，權威勝軍李植以城降。

translations.literal: Now Nianhan was enraged; when the attack on Taiyuan failed he divided his forces toward the capital, passed the southern and northern passes, and Li Zhi of Weisheng army surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Now Nianhan raged; failing at Taiyuan he split toward the capital, passed the passes, and Li Zhi of Weisheng surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，陷隆德府，知府張確、通判趙伯臻、司錄張彥遹死之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Longde prefecture fell; prefect Zhang Que, vice prefect Zhao Bozhen, and registrar Zhang Yanyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Longde fell; Zhang Que, Zhao Bozhen, and Zhang Yanyuan died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，有二流星，一出張宿入濁沒，一出北河入軫。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: two meteors—one from the Zhang lodge into the Turbid and gone, one from the North River into the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, two meteors—one from Zhang into the Turbid, one from the North River into the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔遙郡承宣使有功應除正任者，自今除正任刺史。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: an edict—remote-prefecture honorary commissioners with merit who should receive regular appointment were from now on made regular prefects.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, meritorious honorary commissioners were to become regular prefects.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，梁方平坐棄河津，伏誅。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Liang Fangping was executed for abandoning the river crossing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Liang Fangping was beheaded for abandoning the ford.

sentences.zh: 王孝迪罷。

translations.literal: Wang Xiaodi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiaodi left office.

sentences.zh: 命給事中王雲、侍衛親軍馬軍都指揮使曹曚使金國，鎮洮軍節度使、中太乙宮使种師道為河北、河東路宣撫使，保靜軍節度使、殿前副都指揮使姚古為制置使。

translations.literal: Supervisor of the Secretariat Wang Yun and Palace Horse Guard commander Cao Meng were sent to the Jin state; Zhendi military commissioner and Central Grand Unity commissioner Zhong Shidao was made Hebei-Hedong commissioner; Baojing military commissioner and vice commander of the Palace Front Yao Gu was made deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yun and Cao Meng went to Jin; Zhong Shidao became Hebei-Hedong commissioner; Yao Gu his deputy.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，禦殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the emperor resumed meals in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Qinzong ate again in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，下哀痛之詔於陝西、河東。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: a grief edict was issued to Shaanxi and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, a grief edict went to Shaanxi and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 是月，金人犯澤 州之高平，知州高世由往犒之，乃去。

translations.literal: That month Jin invaded Gaoping in Ze prefecture; prefect Gao Shiyou went out to reward them and they left.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jin hit Gaoping in Ze; Gao Shiyou went out with gifts and they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯朔，遣徽猷閣待制宋煥奉表道君皇帝行宮。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingmao new moon: Palace Gentleman of the Hall of Literary Elegance Song Huan was sent with a memorial to the Lord Emperor of the Dao’s traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingmao new moon: Song Huan carried a memorial to Huizong’s traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 詔侍從言事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered attendants to speak on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants were told to speak freely.

sentences.zh: 詔非三省、樞密院所奉旨，諸司不許奉行。

translations.literal: An edict: orders not presented by the Three Departments and Military Affairs were not to be obeyed by the ministries.
translations.idiomatic: Ministries were not to obey orders unless the Three Departments and Military Affairs sent them.

sentences.zh: 罷川路歲所遣使。

translations.literal: The annual Sichuan circuit envoy was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The yearly Sichuan envoy was cut.

sentences.zh: 募人掩軍民遺骸，遣使分就四郊致祭。

translations.literal: Men were hired to bury soldiers’ and civilians’ remains; envoys were sent to offer sacrifice at the four suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: Laborers buried the dead; envoys sacrificed at the four suburbs.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，李棁罷為鴻慶宮使。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Li Zhi was dismissed and made commissioner of the Palace of Grand Felicity.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Li Zhi became commissioner of the Palace of Grand Felicity.

sentences.zh: 己巳，張邦昌罷為中太一宮使。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Zhang Bangchang was dismissed and made commissioner of the Central Grand Unity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Zhang Bangchang became commissioner of the Central Grand Unity Palace.

sentences.zh: 徐處仁為太宰兼門下侍郎，唐恪為中書侍郎，翰林學士何㮚為尚書右丞，御史中丞許翰同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Xu Churen became Grand Chancellor concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery; Tang Que Vice Director of the Secretariat; Hanlin academician He Li Vice Director of the Right; Censor-in-chief Xu Han associate director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Churen took the grand chancellery; Tang Que the secretariat; He Li right vice director; Xu Han associate at Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，宇文虛中罷知青州。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Yu Wen Xuzhong was dismissed and made prefect of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Yu Wen Xuzhong went to Qing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詣景靈東宮行恭謝禮。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: he performed the thanksgiving rite at the Eastern Shrine of the Brilliant Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, he gave thanks at the Eastern Shrine of the Brilliant Spirit.

sentences.zh: 命趙野為道君皇帝行宮奉迎使。

translations.literal: Zhao Ye was made commissioner to welcome the Lord Emperor of the Dao’s traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ye was sent to welcome Huizong’s traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，恭謝景靈西宮及建隆觀。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: thanksgiving at the Western Shrine of the Brilliant Spirit and the Shrine of Founding Felicity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, thanksgiving at the Western Brilliant Spirit and Founding Felicity shrines.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詣陽德觀、凝祥池、中太乙宮、佑神觀、相國寺。

translations.literal: Day yihai: he visited the Shrine of Yang Virtue, the Pool of Condensed Auspice, the Central Grand Unity Palace, the Shrine of Assisting the Spirit, and the Xiangguo Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, he visited Yang Virtue, Condensed Auspice, Central Grand Unity, Assisting Spirit, and Xiangguo Monastery.

sentences.zh: 丙子，改擷景園為甯德宮。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Garden of Gathering Splendor was renamed the Palace of Tranquil Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Garden of Gathering Splendor became the Palace of Tranquil Virtue.

sentences.zh: 錄司馬光後。

translations.literal: Descendants of Sima Guang were recorded in the registers.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Guang’s line was entered in the registers.

sentences.zh: 己卯，燕王俁、越王偲為太師。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Prince of Yan You and Prince of Yue Sui were made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Princes You of Yan and Sui of Yue became Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔金人叛盟深入，其元主和議李邦彥、奉使許地李棁、李鄴、鄭望之悉行罷黜。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict—Jin had broken the treaty and penetrated deep; Li Bangyan, who had chiefly made peace, and Li Zhi, Li Ye, and Zheng Wangzhi, who had ceded territory on embassy, were all dismissed and demoted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, with Jin deep in breach, peace-maker Li Bangyan and cession-envoys Li Zhi, Li Ye, and Zheng Wangzhi were all cashiered.

sentences.zh: 又詔种師道、姚古、种師中往援三鎮，保塞陵寢所在，誓當固守。

translations.literal: Another edict: Zhong Shidao, Yao Gu, and Zhong Shizhong were sent to relieve the three prefectures and guard where the imperial tombs lay, vowing to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Shidao, Yao Gu, and Zhong Shizhong were sent to save the three prefectures and the tomb districts, with orders to hold.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣李綱迎道君皇帝于南京，以徐處仁為禮儀使。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Li Gang was sent to welcome the Lord Emperor of the Dao at Nanjing; Xu Churen was made ritual commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Li Gang went to Nanjing to welcome Huizong; Xu Churen handled ritual.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史李擢、左司諫李會罷。

translations.literal: Palace censor Li Zhuo and left remonstrator Li Hui were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhuo and Li Hui left office.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，迎道君皇帝于宜春苑，太后入居甯德宮。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the Lord Emperor of the Dao was welcomed at the Yichun Garden; the empress dowager moved into the Palace of Tranquil Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Huizong was welcomed at Yichun Garden; the empress dowager entered Tranquil Virtue Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，知中山府詹度為資政殿大學士，知太原府張孝純、知河間府陳遘並為資政殿學士，知澤州高世由直龍圖閣，賞城守之勞也。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Zhongshan prefect Zhan Du was made Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance; Taiyuan prefect Zhang Xiaochun and Hejian prefect Chen Sui Academicians of the Palace Hall; Ze prefecture Gao Shiyou Gentleman of the Dragon Diagram—rewards for holding their cities.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zhan Du, Zhang Xiaochun, and Chen Sui were advanced for holding Zhongshan, Taiyuan, and Hejian; Gao Shiyou of Ze took Dragon Diagram for his defense.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，朝于甯德宮，詔扈從行宮官吏，候還京日優加賞典，除有罪之人迫於公議已行遣外，餘令台諫勿復用前事糾言。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: audience at the Palace of Tranquil Virtue; an edict—for officials of the traveling palace, when the capital was regained they would receive preferential rewards; except those guilty and already sent away under public outcry, the censorate was not again to raise old matters against the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, he attended at Tranquil Virtue; traveling-palace staff were promised reward on return—except the guilty already banished, censors were not to dig up old cases.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，肅王樞為太傅。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Prince Su was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Prince Su became Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 姚古復隆德府。

translations.literal: Yao Gu recovered Longde prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Gu retook Longde.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，復威勝軍。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Weisheng army was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Weisheng army was retaken.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太保景王杞、濟王栩為太傅。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Junior Grand Guardian Prince of Jing Qi and Prince of Ji Xu were made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Princes Qi of Jing and Xu of Ji became Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 有流星出紫微垣。

translations.literal: A meteor came out of the Purple Forbidden enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor left the Purple Forbidden enclosure.

sentences.zh: 甲午，康王構為集慶、建雄軍節度使，尚書戶部侍郎錢蓋為陝西制置使。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Prince Kang Gou was made military commissioner of Jiqing and Jianxiong armies; Vice Minister of Revenue Qian Gai was made Shaanxi commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Prince Kang Gou took Jiqing and Jianxiong; Qian Gai became Shaanxi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命陳東初品官，賜同進士出身，辭不拜。

translations.literal: Chen Dong was ordered to initial-rank office and granted jinshi status by imperial favor; he declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dong was offered initial rank and jinshi by grace; he refused.

sentences.zh: 籍朱勔家。

translations.literal: Zhu Mian’s household was registered for confiscation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Mian’s property was seized.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔金歸朝官民未發遣者，止之。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict—Song officials and people who had submitted to Jin and not yet been sent away were to be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, those who had gone over to Jin but not yet been expelled were halted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，貶蔡京為崇信軍節度副使。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Cai Jing was demoted to vice commissioner of Chongxin army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Cai Jing was demoted to Chongxin vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是春，夏人取天德、雲內、武州及河東八館。

translations.literal: That spring the Xia took Tiande, Yunnei, Wu prefecture, and the eight Hedong lodges.
translations.idiomatic: That spring the Western Xia took Tiande, Yunnei, Wu, and eight Hedong lodges.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，夏人陷震威城，攝知城事朱昭死之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuxu: the Xia took Zhenwei city; acting prefect Zhu Zhao died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuxu: Western Xia took Zhenwei; acting prefect Zhu Zhao died.

sentences.zh: 己亥，迎太上皇帝入都門。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Emperor Emeritus was welcomed inside the capital gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the Emperor Emeritus entered the capital gate.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，朝于龍德宮。

translations.literal: Day renyin: audience at the Palace of Dragon Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, he attended at Dragon Virtue Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，立子諶為皇太子。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the son Chen was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the son Chen became crown prince.

sentences.zh: 耿南仲為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Geng Nanzhong was made Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Nanzhong became chancellery vice director.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，置《春秋》博士。

translations.literal: Day yisi: a Spring and Autumn doctorate was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, a Spring and Autumn doctorate was set up.

sentences.zh: 戊申，置詳議司於尚書省，討論祖宗法。

translations.literal: Day wushen: a Detailed Deliberation Office was placed in the Ministry of Revenue to discuss ancestral law.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, a Detailed Deliberation Office in the Ministry of Revenue was to recover ancestral law.

sentences.zh: 己酉，乾龍節，群臣上壽於紫宸殿。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: on the Qianlong festival the ministers offered longevity at the Hall of Purple Brightness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Qianlong day, the court wished him long life at Purple Brightness Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，趙野罷。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Zhao Ye was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhao Ye left office.

sentences.zh: 壬子，金人使賈霆、冉企弓來。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Jin sent Jia Ting and Ran Qigong.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Jin sent Jia Ting and Ran Qigong.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，封太師、沂國公鄭紳為樂平郡王。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Grand Preceptor, Duke of Yi Zheng Shen was enfeoffed Prince of Leping commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Grand Preceptor Zheng Shen of Yi became Prince of Leping.

sentences.zh: 貶童貫為昭化軍節度副使、安置郴州。

translations.literal: Tong Guan was demoted to vice commissioner of Zhaohua army and settled at Chen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Guan was demoted to Zhaohua vice commissioner and sent to Chen.

sentences.zh: 減宰執俸給三之一及支賜之半。

translations.literal: Councilors’ salaries were cut by one third and stipends by half.
translations.idiomatic: Councilors’ pay was cut a third; stipends halved.

sentences.zh: 詔開經筵。

translations.literal: An edict opened the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: The classics lecture was opened.

sentences.zh: 令吏部稽考庶官，凡由楊戩、李彥之公田，王黼、朱勔之應奉，童貫西北之師，孟昌齡河防之役，夔蜀、湖南之開疆，關陝、河東之改幣，及近習所引，獻頌可采，特赴殿試之流，所爵賞，悉奪之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel was ordered to review all officials: anyone who had gained office through Yang Jian’s or Li Yan’s public fields, Wang Fu’s or Zhu Mian’s tribute missions, Tong Guan’s northwest campaigns, Meng Changling’s river works, the opening of Kuizhou-Shu and Hunan, the currency changes in Guan-Shaan and Hedong, or introductions by close attendants, or who had offered praise the throne could use, or who had been specially summoned to palace examination—all ranks and rewards were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel was told to scour every officer raised by Yang Jian’s and Li Yan’s fields, Wang Fu’s and Zhu Mian’s tribute, Tong Guan’s northwest wars, Meng Changling’s rivers, Kuizhou and Hunan expansion, Guan-Shaan and Hedong coinage, court favorites, praise offerings, and special palace exams—and strip rank from all.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，种師道加太尉、同知樞密院事、河北河東路宣撫使。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Zhong Shidao was made Grand Marshal, associate director of Military Affairs, and Hebei-Hedong commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Zhong Shidao became Grand Marshal, associate at Military Affairs, and Hebei-Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔自今假日特坐，百司毋得休務。

translations.literal: Day yimao: an edict—on special holiday audiences all offices were not to cease business.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, special holiday audiences would not excuse offices from duty.

sentences.zh: 以平涼軍節度使范訥為右金吾衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Pingliang military commissioner Fan Ne was made senior general of the Right Golden Crow Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ne of Pingliang became senior general of the Right Golden Crow Guard.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔有告奸人妄言金人復至以恐動居民者，賞之。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: an edict—whoever reported slanderers who falsely said Jin would come again to frighten the people would be rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, informers who exposed false alarms of a second Jin descent would be paid.

sentences.zh: 戊午，進封南康郡王栻為和王，平陽郡王榛為信王。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Prince of Nankang Shi was advanced to Prince of He; Prince of Pingyang Zhen to Prince of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Prince Shi of Nankang became Prince of He; Prince Zhen of Pingyang, Prince of Xin.

sentences.zh: 己未，復以詩賦取士，禁用《莊》、《老》及王安石《字說》。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: poetry and rhapsody were restored for selecting scholars; Zhuangzi, Laozi, and Wang Anshi’s Explaining Graphs were banned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, examinations returned to poetry and rhapsody; Zhuangzi, Laozi, and Wang Anshi’s character book were banned.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔親擢台諫官，宰執勿得薦舉，著為令。

translations.literal: Day renxu: an edict—the emperor would personally select censors and remonstrators; councilors were not to recommend; this was made a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Qinzong would pick censors himself—councilors could not nominate—and the rule was fixed.

sentences.zh: 追政和以來道官、處士、先生封贈奏補等敕書。

translations.literal: Edicts since Zhenghe granting Daoist titles, recluse honors, and “master” enfeoffments and supplemental appointments were revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe-era Daoist, recluse, and “master” honors and backdoor appointments were revoked.

sentences.zh: 甲子，令在京監察御史、在外監司、郡守及路分鈐轄已上，舉曾經邊任或有武勇可以統眾出戰者，人二員。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: capital investigating censors, circuit supervisors, prefects, and route commanders and above were to recommend two men each who had held border posts or had martial courage fit to command armies in the field.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, capital censors, circuit supervisors, prefects, and route commanders were each to name two border veterans or brave men fit to lead in battle.

sentences.zh: 東兵正將占沆與金人戰於交城縣，死之。

translations.literal: Eastern-army captain Zhan Kang fought Jin at Jiao county and died.
translations.idiomatic: Captain Zhan Kang of the eastern army fought Jin at Jiao county and fell.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔三衙並諸路帥司各舉諳練邊事、智勇過人並豪俊奇傑、眾所推服、堪充統制將領者各五名。

translations.literal: Day yichou: an edict—the Three Guards and every circuit military commissioner were each to recommend five men skilled on the border, surpassing in wisdom and courage, or outstanding and strange heroes whom the multitude would follow, fit to be commanders.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the Three Guards and every circuit commissioner were each to name five border-wise, brave, or crowd-backed men fit for command.

sentences.zh: 貶蔡攸節度副使，安置朱勔於循州。

translations.literal: Cai You was demoted to vice commissioner; Zhu Mian was settled at Xun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Cai You was demoted to vice commissioner; Zhu Mian was sent to Xun.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅朔，朝于龍德宮，令提舉官日具太上皇帝起居平安以聞。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingyin new moon: audience at the Palace of Dragon Virtue; commissioners were ordered to report the Emperor Emeritus’s daily peace.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingyin new moon: court at Dragon Virtue; commissioners daily reported Huizong’s health.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔天下有能以財穀佐軍者，有司以名聞，推恩有差。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: an edict—whoever in the realm could supply grain or wealth to the armies was to be reported by name for graded favor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, those who could feed the armies with grain or cash were to be named for reward.

sentences.zh: 以少傅、鎮西軍節度余深為特進、觀文殿大學士。

translations.literal: Junior Preceptor, Zhenxi military commissioner Yu Shen was made Special Advanced and Academician of the Palace Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Shen of Zhenxi became Special Advanced and palace academician.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷王安石配享孔子廟庭。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Wang Anshi’s place in Confucius’s temple court was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wang Anshi was removed from Confucius’s temple.

sentences.zh: 庚午，少傅、安武軍節度使錢景臻，鎮安軍節度使、開府儀同三司劉宗元並為左金吾衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Junior Preceptor, Anwu military commissioner Qian Jingzhen and Zhen’an military commissioner, Pillar of the State Liu Zongyuan were both made senior generals of the Left Golden Crow Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Qian Jingzhen of Anwu and Liu Zongyuan of Zhen’an became left Golden Crow senior generals.

sentences.zh: 保信軍節度使劉敷、武成軍節度使劉敏、向德軍節度使張楙、岳陽軍節度使王舜臣、應道軍節度度使朱孝孫、瀘川軍節度使錢忱並為右金吾衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Baoxin military commissioner Liu Fu, Wucheng military commissioner Liu Min, Xiangde military commissioner Zhang Mao, Yueyang military commissioner Wang Shunchen, Yingdao military commissioner Zhu Xiaosun, and Luchuan military commissioner Qian Chen were all made senior generals of the Right Golden Crow Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Fu, Liu Min, Zhang Mao, Wang Shunchen, Zhu Xiaosun, and Qian Chen became right Golden Crow senior generals.

sentences.zh: 是日，寒。

translations.literal: That day was cold.
translations.idiomatic: That day was bitter cold.

sentences.zh: 辛未，申銅禁。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the copper ban was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the copper ban was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 詔：無出身待制已上，年及三十而通歷任實及十年者，乃得任子。

translations.literal: An edict: holders of office without examination origin at awaiting-edict rank and above, aged thirty with ten years of actual service in successive posts, might confer rank on sons.
translations.idiomatic: Awaiting-edict officers without examination pedigree, thirty years old with ten years’ real service, might confer rank on sons.

sentences.zh: 監察御史余應求坐言事迎合大臣，罷知衛州。

translations.literal: Investigating censor Yu Yingqiu was dismissed for speaking to please the great ministers and made prefect of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yingqiu was cashiered for flattering the council and sent to Wei prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，曲赦河北路。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: a partial pardon was granted to Hebei circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Hebei received a partial pardon.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，申銷金禁。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the gold ban was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the gold ban was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔以儉約先天下，澄冗汰貪，為民除害，授監司、郡縣奉行所未及者，凡十有六事。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict—to take frugality before the realm, clarify redundancy and purge greed, remove harm for the people—sixteen matters for circuit supervisors and prefects to carry out that had not yet been done.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, sixteen austerity orders went to circuit supervisors and prefects: cut waste, purge greed, spare the people.

sentences.zh: 姚古將兵至威勝，聞粘罕將至，眾驚潰，河東大振。

translations.literal: Yao Gu led troops to Weisheng; hearing Nianhan was coming, the army panicked and fled; Hedong was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Gu reached Weisheng; at word Nianhan was near the army broke; Hedong shook.

sentences.zh: 河北、河東路制置副使种師中與金人戰於榆次，死之。

translations.literal: Hebei-Hedong deputy commissioner Zhong Shizhong fought Jin at Yuci and died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Shizhong fought Jin at Yuci and fell.

sentences.zh: 己卯，借外任官職田一年。

translations.literal: Day jimao: outer officials’ salary fields were borrowed for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, salary fields of officials outside the capital were borrowed for a year.

sentences.zh: 開府儀同三司高俅卒。

translations.literal: Pillar of the State Gao Qiu died.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qiu died.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，損太官日進膳。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the Imperial Kitchen’s daily offerings were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the Imperial Kitchen’s daily table was cut.

sentences.zh: 追削高俅官。

translations.literal: Gao Qiu’s offices were posthumously stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qiu’s offices were posthumously stripped.

sentences.zh: 甲申，罷詳議司。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the Detailed Deliberation Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Detailed Deliberation Office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以河東經略安撫使張孝純為檢校少保、武當軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Hedong pacification commissioner Zhang Xiaochun was made acting Junior Guardian and military commissioner of Wudang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Hedong pacification commissioner Zhang Xiaochun became acting Junior Guardian and Wudang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔天下舉習武藝、兵書者。

translations.literal: Day renchen: an edict called throughout the realm for those skilled in martial arts and military texts.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the realm was called to present those skilled in arms and military texts.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔姚古援太原。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict ordered Yao Gu to relieve Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Yao Gu was ordered to relieve Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申朔，以道君皇帝還朝，禦紫宸殿，受群臣朝賀。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingchen new moon: because the Retired Emperor had returned to court, he held audience at the Purple Forbidden Hall and received the ministers’ congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingchen new moon: with the Retired Emperor back at court, he held audience at the Purple Forbidden Hall and received the ministers.

sentences.zh: 詔諫官極論闕失。

translations.literal: An edict ordered remonstrance officials to speak exhaustively on shortcomings.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance officials were ordered to speak exhaustively on shortcomings.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，令中外舉文武官才堪將帥者。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the court and the outer offices were ordered to recommend civil and military officials whose talent suited command.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, court and outer offices were ordered to recommend civil and military men fit for command.

sentences.zh: 時太原圍急，群臣欲割三鎮地，李綱沮之，乃以李綱代种師道為宣撫使、援太原。

translations.literal: At the time Taiyuan was tightly besieged; the ministers wished to cede the three circuits, but Li Gang blocked it; Li Gang was then made pacification commissioner in Zhong Shidao’s place to relieve Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan was tightly besieged; ministers wished to cede the three circuits, but Li Gang blocked it, and Li Gang replaced Zhong Shidao as pacification commissioner to relieve Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以資政殿學士劉韐為宣撫副使，陝西制置司都統制解潛為制置副使。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Liu Ge was made deputy pacification commissioner, and Hedong circuit commissioner-general Jie Qian was made deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Liu Ge became deputy pacification commissioner and Jie Qian deputy commissioner-general.

sentences.zh: 太白犯歲星。

translations.literal: Great White crossed the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: Venus crossed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，封鄆國公楃為安康郡王，韓國公楗為廣平郡王，並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Duke of Yan State Bian was enfeoffed Prince of Ankang commandery, Duke of Han State Jian Prince of Guangping commandery; both received opening-establishment rank equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Duke of Yan Bian became Prince of Ankang and Duke of Han Jian Prince of Guangping; both received opening-establishment rank equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 詔：「今日政令，惟遵奉上皇詔書，修復祖宗故事。

translations.literal: An edict: “Today’s government orders shall only follow the Retired Emperor’s edicts and restore the ancestral institutions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict: “Today’s orders shall only follow the Retired Emperor’s edicts and restore ancestral institutions.

sentences.zh: 群臣庶士亦當講孔、孟之正道，察安石舊說之不當者，羽翼朕志，以濟中興。

translations.literal: Ministers and common scholars should also expound the correct way of Confucius and Mencius, discern what was improper in Wang Anshi’s old doctrines, and support Our resolve to achieve restoration.”
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and scholars should expound Confucius and Mencius, discern Wang Anshi’s errors, and support Our restoration.”

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，以侍衛親軍馬軍副都指揮使、鎮西軍承宣使王稟為建武軍節度使，錄堅守太原之功也。

translations.literal: Day guimao: deputy commander of the Palace Attendant Horse Army and Zhenxi Army commissioner Wang Bing was made Jianwu military commissioner, recording his merit in stoutly defending Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Wang Bing became Jianwu military commissioner, recording his stout defense of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，路允迪罷為醴泉觀使。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Lu Yundi was dismissed and made superintendent of the Liquan Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Lu Yundi was dismissed as superintendent of Liquan Abbey.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，左司諫陳公輔以言事責監合州酒務。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Left remonstrance bureau drafter Chen Gongfu, for memorializing on affairs, was punished by supervision of Hezhou wine tax.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Chen Gongfu was punished with supervision of Hezhou wine tax for memorializing on affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，天狗墜地。

translations.literal: Day renzi: a celestial dog fell to earth.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, a celestial dog fell to earth.

sentences.zh: 有聲如雷。

translations.literal: The sound was like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: The sound was like thunder.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day guichou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，太白、熒感、歲、鎮四星合于張。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Great White, Sparkling Deluder, Year Star, and Queller Star all met in Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn all met in Zhang.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷都水、將作監承受內侍官。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Directorates of Waterways and Palace Construction were forbidden to employ eunuch receivers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Waterways and Palace Construction directorates were forbidden eunuch receivers.

sentences.zh: 熙河都統制焦安節坐不法，李綱斬之。

translations.literal: Hexi circuit commissioner-general Jiao Anjie was guilty of lawlessness; Li Gang executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Hexi commissioner-general Jiao Anjie broke the law; Li Gang executed him.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，姚古坐擁兵逗遛，貶為節度副使、安置廣州。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Yao Gu, guilty of holding troops and dawdling, was demoted to military vice commissioner and placed at Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yao Gu was demoted to military vice commissioner and placed at Guangzhou for holding troops and dawdling.

sentences.zh: 彗出紫微垣。

translations.literal: A comet appeared in the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: A comet appeared in the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑朔，除元符上書邪等之禁。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yichou new moon: the ban on Yuanfu memorialists of heterodox rank was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yichou new moon: the ban on Yuanfu heterodox memorialists was lifted.

sentences.zh: 宋昭政和中上書諫攻遼，貶連州；

translations.literal: In the Zhenghe era Song Zhao had memorialized against attacking Liao and was demoted to Lianzhou;
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenghe, Song Zhao had memorialized against attacking Liao and was demoted to Lianzhou;

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔赴都堂。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: an edict summoned him to the chief ministers’ hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, he was summoned to the chief ministers’ hall.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，安置蔡京於儋州，攸雷州，童貫吉陽軍。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Cai Jing was placed at Danzhou, Cai You at Leizhou, and Tong Guan at Jiyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Cai Jing was placed at Danzhou, Cai You at Leizhou, and Tong Guan at Jiyang Army.

sentences.zh: 己卯，免借河北、河東、陝西路職田。

translations.literal: Day jimao: official-field loans in Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi circuits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, official-field loans in Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔蔡京子孫二十三人已分竄遠地，遇赦不許量移。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: an edict—Cai Jing’s twenty-three sons and grandsons, already scattered to distant places, were not to be moved nearer on amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou: Cai Jing’s twenty-three sons and grandsons, already scattered afar, were not to be moved nearer on amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是日，京死於潭州。

translations.literal: That day Cai Jing died at Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That day Cai Jing died at Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，令侍從官共議改修宣仁聖烈皇后謗史。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: attendant officials were ordered jointly to revise the slanderous history of Empress Xuanren the Sagely and Liege.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, attendant officials were ordered jointly to revise the slanderous history of Empress Xuanren.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣監察御史張澂誅童貫，廣西轉運副使李升之誅趙良嗣，並竄其子孫于海南。

translations.literal: Day renchen: investigating censor Zhang Cheng was sent to execute Tong Guan, and Guangxi transport vice commissioner Li Shengzhi to execute Zhao Liangsi; their sons and grandsons were all banished to Hainan.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Zhang Cheng was sent to execute Tong Guan and Li Shengzhi Zhao Liangsi; their descendants were banished to Hainan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，侍御史李光坐言事貶監當。

translations.literal: Day guichen: attendant censor Li Guang, guilty of memorializing, was demoted to grain supervision.
translations.idiomatic: On guichen, Li Guang was demoted to grain supervision for memorializing.

sentences.zh: 是月，解潛與金人戰于南關，敗績。

translations.literal: That month Jie Qian fought the Jin at Nanguan and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jie Qian fought the Jin at Nanguan and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 劉韐自遼州引兵與金人戰，敗績。

translations.literal: Liu Ge led troops from Liaozhou against the Jin and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ge led troops from Liaozhou against the Jin and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午朔，錄陳瓘後。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiawu new moon: Chen Guan’s descendants were ennobled.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiawu new moon: Chen Guan’s descendants were ennobled.

sentences.zh: 丙申，復命种師道以宣撫使巡邊，召李綱還。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Zhong Shidao was again ordered pacification commissioner to tour the borders; Li Gang was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Zhong Shidao was again made pacification commissioner to tour the borders; Li Gang was recalled.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔以彗星，避殿減膳，令從臣具民間疾苦以聞。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: because of the comet, the emperor left the hall and reduced meals, ordering attendant ministers to set forth the people’s hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, because of the comet the emperor left the hall and reduced meals and ordered ministers to report the people’s hardships.

sentences.zh: 河東察訪使張灝與金人戰于文水，敗績。

translations.literal: Hedong investigating commissioner Zhang Hao fought the Jin at Wenshui and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong investigating commissioner Zhang Hao fought the Jin at Wenshui and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔求民之疾苦者十七事，悉除之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: an edict sought seventeen categories of the people’s hardships and abolished them all.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, seventeen categories of popular hardship were sought and abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁未，斡離不復攻廣信軍、保州，不克，遂犯真定。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Wolibu again attacked Guangxin Army and Baozhou but could not take them, then invaded Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Wolibu again attacked Guangxin and Baozhou without success, then invaded Zhending.

sentences.zh: 戊申，都統制張思正等夜襲金人于文水縣，敗之。

translations.literal: Day wushen: commissioner-general Zhang Sizheng by night raided the Jin at Wenshui county and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhang Sizheng by night raided the Jin at Wenshui and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 己酉，復戰，師潰，死者數萬人，思正奔汾州。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: they fought again; the army collapsed and tens of thousands died; Sizheng fled to Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou they fought again; the army collapsed and tens of thousands died; Sizheng fled to Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 都統制折可求師潰于子夏山。

translations.literal: Commissioner-general Zhe Keqiu’s army collapsed at Zixia Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner-general Zhe Keqiu’s army collapsed at Zixia Mountain.

sentences.zh: 威勝、隆德、汾、晉、澤、絳民皆渡河南奔，州縣皆空。

translations.literal: The people of Weisheng, Longde, Fen, Jin, Ze, and Jiang all crossed the Yellow River south to flee; prefectures and counties were empty.
translations.idiomatic: People of Weisheng, Longde, Fen, Jin, Ze, and Jiang all fled south across the Yellow River; prefectures and counties stood empty.

sentences.zh: 金人乘勝攻太原。

translations.literal: The Jin pressed the victory and attacked Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin pressed the victory and attacked Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 錄張庭堅後。

translations.literal: Zhang Tingjian’s descendants were ennobled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingjian’s descendants were ennobled.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣徽猷閣待制王雲、閣門宣贊舍人馬識遠使于金國，秘書著作佐郎劉岑、太常博士李若水分使其軍議和。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Palace Attendant Wang Yun and Gate Bureau praise attendant Ma Shiyuan were sent as envoys to the Jin state; Secretariat editorial assistant Liu Cen and Court of Sacrifices academician Li Ruoshui were sent separately to their armies to discuss peace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Wang Yun and Ma Shiyuan were sent to the Jin; Liu Cen and Li Ruoshui were sent separately to their armies to discuss peace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，許翰罷知亳州。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Xu Han was dismissed as prefect of Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Xu Han was dismissed as Bozhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 己未，太宰徐處仁罷知東平，少宰吳敏罷知揚州。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Grand Preceptor Xu Churen was dismissed as prefect of Dongping; Junior Preceptor Wu Min was dismissed as Yangzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Grand Preceptor Xu Churen was dismissed as Dongping prefect and Junior Preceptor Wu Min as Yangzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 以唐恪為少宰兼中書侍郎，何㮚為中書侍郎，禮部尚書陳過庭為尚書右丞，開封尹聶昌同知樞密院事，御史中丞李回簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Tang Que was made Junior Preceptor and concurrently vice director of the Secretariat; He Xu was made vice director of the Secretariat; Minister of Rites Chen Guoting was made right vice director of the Department of State Affairs; Kaifeng intendant Nie Chang was made associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; chief censor Li Hui was made signing secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Que became Junior Preceptor and Secretariat vice director; He Xu Secretariat vice director; Chen Guoting right vice director; Nie Chang associate military affairs director; Li Hui signing military affairs secretary.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣王雲使金軍，許以三鎮賦稅。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Wang Yun was sent to the Jin army, with the three circuits’ tax levies permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Yun was sent to the Jin army, with the three circuits’ tax levies permitted.

sentences.zh: 是月，福州軍亂，殺其知州事柳庭俊。

translations.literal: That month Fuzhou’s army mutinied and killed its acting prefect Liu Tingjun.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Fuzhou army mutinied and killed acting prefect Liu Tingjun.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，金人陷太原，執安撫使張孝純，副都總管王稟、通判方笈皆死之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingyin: the Jin took Taiyuan, seized pacification commissioner Zhang Xiaochun; deputy commander-general Wang Bing, prefectural judge Fang Ji, and all died.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingyin: the Jin took Taiyuan and seized Zhang Xiaochun; Wang Bing, Fang Ji, and others all died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，貶吳敏為崇信軍節度副使、安置涪州。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Wu Min was demoted to Chongxin military vice commissioner and placed at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Wu Min was demoted to Chongxin military vice commissioner and placed at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 移蔡攸于萬安軍，尋與弟翛及朱勔皆賜死。

translations.literal: Cai You was moved to Wan’an Army; soon he, his brother Xiu, and Zhu Mian were all granted death.
translations.idiomatic: Cai You was moved to Wan’an Army; soon he, his brother Xiu, and Zhu Mian were all granted death.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔編修敕令所取靖康以前蔡京所乞御筆手詔，參祖宗法及今所行者，刪修成書。

translations.literal: Day yihai: an edict ordered the Codification Office to take Cai Jing’s requested imperial-brush edicts before Jingkang, compare them with ancestral law and what was now in force, and delete and revise them into a book.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai: Cai Jing’s pre-Jingkang imperial-brush edicts were ordered collected, compared with ancestral law and current practice, and revised into a book.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禮部尚書王宇為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Minister of Rites Wang Yu was made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Minister of Rites Wang Yu became left vice director.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，有赤氣隨日出。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: red vapor followed the sun as it rose.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, red vapor followed the rising sun.

sentences.zh: 李綱罷知揚州。

translations.literal: Li Gang was dismissed as Yangzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang was dismissed as Yangzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 壬午，梟童貫首於都市。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Tong Guan’s head was displayed in the capital market.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Tong Guan’s head was displayed in the capital market.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賜布衣尹焞為和靖處士。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: commoner Yin Xu was granted the title Hermit of Hejing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, commoner Yin Xu was granted Hermit of Hejing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，日有兩珥、背氣。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the sun had two ear-rings and back-glow.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the sun had two ear-rings and back-glow.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，建三京及鄧州為都總管府，分總四道兵。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the three capitals and Dengzhou were made grand marshal prefectures, each commanding troops of one circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the three capitals and Dengzhou were made grand marshal prefectures, each commanding one circuit’s troops.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以知大名府趙野為北道都總管，知河南府王襄為西道都總管，知鄧州張叔夜為南道都總管，知應天府胡直孺為東道都總管。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Daming prefect Zhao Ye was made north-circuit grand marshal; Henan prefect Wang Xiang west-circuit grand marshal; Dengzhou prefect Zhang Shuye south-circuit grand marshal; Yingtian prefect Hu Zhiru east-circuit grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Zhao Ye became north-circuit grand marshal, Wang Xiang west, Zhang Shuye south, and Hu Zhiru east.

sentences.zh: 又罷李綱提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: Li Gang was again dismissed as superintendent of the Grotto of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang was again dismissed as superintendent of the Grotto of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣給事中黃鍔由海道使金國議和。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Supervisory Attendant Huang E was sent by sea route as envoy to the Jin state to discuss peace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Huang E was sent by sea to the Jin to discuss peace.

sentences.zh: 是月，夏人陷西安州。

translations.literal: That month the Xia took Xi’an prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Xia took Xi’an prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳朔，禦殿復膳。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guisi new moon: the emperor resumed meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guisi new moon: the emperor resumed meals in the hall.

sentences.zh: 貶李鋼為保靜軍節度副使、安置建昌軍。

translations.literal: Li Gang was demoted to Baojing military vice commissioner and placed at Jianchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang was demoted to Baojing military vice commissioner and placed at Jianchang Army.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，金人陷真定，都鈐轄劉竧死之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the Jin took Zhending; commander Liu Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Jin took Zhending; commander Liu Chong died.

sentences.zh: 有流星如杯。

translations.literal: A meteor like a cup appeared.
translations.idiomatic: A cup-sized meteor appeared.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，金人使楊天吉、王汭來。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Jin envoys Yang Tiangi and Wang Rui came.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Jin envoys Yang Tiangi and Wang Rui came.

sentences.zh: 庚子，日有青、赤、黃恩氣。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the sun had green, red, and yellow favor-glow.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the sun showed green, red, and yellow favor-glow.

sentences.zh: 金人陷汾州，知州張克戩、兵馬都監賈亶死之。

translations.literal: The Jin took Fenzhou; prefect Zhang Kezhan and horse-army overseer Jia Dan died.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Fenzhou; Zhang Kezhan and Jia Dan died.

sentences.zh: 又攻平定軍。

translations.literal: They again attacked Pingding Army.
translations.idiomatic: They again attacked Pingding Army.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，下哀痛詔，命河北、河東諸路帥臣傳檄所部，得便宜行事。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: a grief-stricken edict was issued, ordering Hebei and Hedong circuit commanders to circulate proclamations in their jurisdictions and act as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, a grief-stricken edict ordered Hebei and Hedong commanders to circulate proclamations and act as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，天寧節，率群臣詣龍德宮上壽。

translations.literal: Day renyin: on the Heavenly Tranquility festival the emperor led the ministers to Longde Palace to offer birthday felicitations.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, on the Heavenly Tranquility festival the emperor led ministers to Longde Palace for birthday felicitations.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔用蔡京、王黼、童貫所薦人。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: an edict ordered use of men recommended by Cai Jing, Wang Fu, and Tong Guan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, men recommended by Cai Jing, Wang Fu, and Tong Guan were ordered employed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，集從官於尚書省，議割三鎮。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: attendant officials were assembled at the Department of State Affairs to discuss ceding the three circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, attendant officials assembled at the Department of State Affairs to discuss ceding the three circuits.

sentences.zh: 召种師道還。

translations.literal: Zhong Shidao was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Shidao was recalled.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以禮部尚書馮澥知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Minister of Rites Feng Xu was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Minister of Rites Feng Xu became director of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 己酉，閱炮飛山營。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the Flying Mountain catapult camp was reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the Flying Mountain catapult camp was reviewed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以范訥為甯武軍節度使、河北河東路宣撫使。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Fan Na was made Ningwu military commissioner and Hebei-Hedong pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Fan Na became Ningwu military commissioner and Hebei-Hedong pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 遼故將小䩴䩮攻陷麟州建寧砦，知砦楊震死之。

translations.literal: A former Liao general, Xiao Erlü, took Jianning stockade of Lin prefecture; stockade commander Yang Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: Former Liao general Xiao Erlü took Lin’s Jianning stockade; Yang Zhen died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔太常禮官集議金主尊號。

translations.literal: Day renzi: an edict ordered Court of Sacrifices ritual officials to assemble and deliberate the Jin ruler’s honorific title.
